official_youtube_base.evidence: YouTube 20.21.6 verified as com.google.ios.youtube, arm64, cryptid=0; required runtime selector groups are present and the conservative unsigned IPA diff passed byte-level preservation audit.

ad_block_video.evidence: Standalone uses the pinned YouTubeX source. Not included in the legacy VancedCore artifact; device behavior is pending validation.

ad_block_feed.evidence: Standalone uses the pinned YouTubeX renderer filters. Not included in the legacy VancedCore artifact; device behavior is pending validation.

background_playback.evidence: Standalone uses YouTubeX background availability hooks and preserves native YouTube playback. Not included in the legacy VancedCore artifact; device behavior is pending validation.

picture_in_picture.evidence: Standalone compiles the pinned YouPiP and YTVideoOverlay sources with the internal Objective-C hook backend. Device behavior is pending validation.

sponsorblock.evidence: Own VancedSponsorBlock module uses SHA-256 4-character k-anonymous SponsorBlock queries, validates skip segments, tracks active video, and seeks with native YouTube selectors; compiled and linked in successful arm64 core build

return_youtube_dislike.evidence: Own VancedRYD module caches RYD votes API counts, updates YTQTMButton dislike UI for normal playback, and hooks YTReelWatchLikesController for Shorts; compiled and linked in successful arm64 core build

quality_memory_controls.evidence: VancedCore stores qualityLabel from original/redesigned quality controllers and reapplies MLQuickMenuVideoQualitySettingFormatConstraint after player load; compiled and linked in successful arm64 core build

speed_memory_controls.evidence: VancedCore dynamically hooks YTMainAppVideoPlayerOverlayViewController setPlaybackRate: and restores after YTPlayerViewController loadWithPlayerTransition:playbackConfig:; compiled and linked in successful arm64 core build

ui_shorts_controls.evidence: VancedCore filters Shorts shelves/cells outside history; VancedShortsUI removes FEshorts from YTPivotBarView; both are exposed as native Vanced Settings toggles; all related sources compile with -Werror in the arm64 core build; device behavior remains unvalidated

sideload_login_compatibility.evidence: Google SSO/keychain/app-group compatibility after third-party re-signing is not proven by the current VancedCore.

notification_preservation.evidence: All five original app extensions and Info.plist are preserved byte-for-byte, but actual push delivery after re-signing depends on provisioning/APS entitlements.

repository_ipa_packaging.evidence: The Makefile PACKAGE_IPA path sets MODULES=jailed, but dependencies.lock.json does not install the external theos-jailed module. The audited output IPA used the separate conservative Mach-O packaging path.
